title: Snow Rider 3D
desc: Snow Rider 3D sends a sled down a bright, snowy slope full of rocks, barriers and quick line changes. Collect gifts, unlock new sleds and chase a longer run every time. It is a natural winter companion to Speed Slope's downhill reflex loop.
howto: Start the run and let the sled build speed.
Steer left and right to stay on the clear line.
Jump over logs, ramps and sudden obstacles.
Use unlocks and practice to extend your best distance.
tips: Pick your lane early instead of swiping at the last moment.
Keep small corrections small; the sled still slides after input.
Learn where ramps give a safer line over obstacles.
